create_headless_text_drawer: create a HeadlessTextDrawer instance to add text without rendering in headless mode
create_text_drawer: create a TextDrawer with framebuffer size, font path, and display font size parameters
add_text_to_screen: add text to the screen with alignment, delta offsets, and destination mask options
draw_text_on_screen: draw all collected text on screen using Magnum GPU rendering with blending enabled
use_text_alignment_enum: use TextOnScreenAlignment enum to position text at TOP_LEFT, CENTER, or BOTTOM_RIGHT
